incident-bot: Pager: SEV-1 — GPU pool 'eu-prod-gpu' saturated. queue_length=2800, p95_latency=12.4s, error_rate=8%. dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/ops/eu-prod-gpu (auto-triggered at 2026-03-15T18:07:09Z)

katie (oncall): ACK — I'm on it. Noted customer-facing 503/timeout reports. Opening thread here for live coord.

raj (sre): I'm looking at autoscaler logs now. It appears we're hitting a hard scale limit: attempted scale beyond 128 GPUs -> cloud returns 429 / quotaExceeded. Lots of scale retries.

maria (eng-runtime): Confirming. From autoscaler logs:
```
2026-03-15T18:06:42Z autoscaler: request_scale -> desired=160 current=96
2026-03-15T18:06:43Z cloud-api: CreateInstance -> 429 RateLimitExceeded (retryable)
2026-03-15T18:06:44Z autoscaler: scale failed -> provider_error=quotaExceeded
2026-03-15T18:06:47Z autoscaler: retrying with backoff (attempt 3)
```
We also see burst requests from a few heavy embedding jobs pushing long batch windows.

katie (oncall): Any quick mitigations? Can we throttle long-running batches or route traffic to a fallback pool?

maria (eng-runtime): Two quick levers:
- enable fallback routing to us-west fallback pool (cheaper model variant / smaller batch sizes)
- apply emergency rate-limiting policy to long-running jobs
I can flip a routing flag now: `rbctl route set --pool eu-prod-gpu --fallback us-west-fallback --pct 10`

doug (ops): I'm checking cloud quotas. Console shows region quota max=160 but our project currently limited to 140. We submitted quota increase request (cloud ticket 12345) a minute ago. I can also temporarily bump autoscaler max if you want, but if quota isn't increased we'll just get errors.

raj (sre): I'd prefer routing + rate-limit to buy steady drain before touching autoscaler max. If we bump max without quota, we risk more failed creates.

ellen (product): Customer impact: we're seeing transactional latency spikes and ~120 tenants with increased 5xxs (top impacted are embedding-heavy teams). Sending a quick status update to customers now. Who's owning comms?

katie (oncall): Ellen please post the short ack (we'll follow up). I'm enabling fallback routing 10% now to reduce pressure — will report metrics in 2m.

maria (eng-runtime): Done: `rbctl route set --pool eu-prod-gpu --fallback us-west-fallback --pct 10` -> routing flag committed. Also applied short-term rate-limit policy to known long batch endpoints: `policy apply /v1/embeddings long_batch_limit=30s`

katie (oncall): Queue dropped from 2800 -> 1900 in ~3m after routing + rate-limit. Latency p95 decreased to 9.1s. Good sign.

maria (eng-runtime): Autoscaler still getting intermittent 429s but backoffs are helping. Switching instance request type to non-spot (less throttling) for new nodes in progress.

doug (ops): Cloud support responded — quota increase approved to 160. I'm raising autoscaler max from 128 -> 160 now: `autoscaler set --pool eu-prod-gpu --max-instances 160` (pushing change).

raj (sre): Autoscaler scale activity now shows new instances provisioning. Current pool ~152 GPUs. Queue length trending down to 600 and dropping.

katie (oncall): Monitoring for stability. Let's keep page open 30m after queue stable. If we get through that we'll hand off a postmortem/next steps.

incident-bot: Alert: queue stabilized (<200) for 5m. Mitigation stage: manual interventions and quota bump succeeded.

katie (oncall): Good work. Quick summary + immediate action items before we close:
- Owners: raj (RCA lead), maria (runtime fixes), doug (cloud/quota ops)
- Actions taken: enabled 10% fallback routing, applied emergency rate-limits, switched new nodes to non-spot, bumped autoscaler max to 160
- Short-term: document the commands used and timestamps, verify rollback plan for routing flag
- Long-term follow-ups: autoscaler observability (trace provider 429s), pre-warm quotas for peak windows, stronger detection for heavy batch jobs

ellen (product): I'll draft a short customer follow-up and link to postmortem when ready. Tag me for review.

raj (sre): Creating initial postmortem draft in #eng-sre. Preliminary timeline and logs attached will include: autoscaler failures, cloud 429s, routing flip at 18:10Z, quota increase at 18:13Z, queue drain complete at 18:25Z.

doug (ops): Cloud ticket #12345 closure note: quota increased; recommend we pre-request region quota increases one day before expected high-traffic events. Adding runbook item.

katie (oncall): Handing off incident -> monitor window 30m. Postmortem meeting scheduled: #eng-sre tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Closing active page but leaving thread for notes. :white_check_mark:

maria (eng-runtime): I'll also add better autoscaler telemetry (provider error codes, request IDs) so next time we can correlate to cloud-side rate limits.

incident-bot: Incident closed by katie (oncall) at 2026-03-15T18:37:25Z. Recording participants and actions for postmortem.

katie (oncall): Final note: save the exact commands we ran into the postmortem (rbctl route set..., policy apply..., autoscaler set...). Thanks team.
